name: Panel
description:
The standard content pane: glass-panel, surface radius, header/body/footer slots.
Every Panel is an inline-size container named `panel`, so anything inside it lays out
against the panel's width — never the viewport's.
signature: ({ scroll, compact, glass, className, ...rest }: PanelProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: compact
props.description:
Tighten the inset of the header, body and footer to `--inset-panel-compact`, for dense tool
panes. It follows density and UI scale like `--inset-panel`: 12px at the default scale under
comfortable density and 8px under compact density, against 20px and 16px for a regular panel.
A Panel nested inside keeps its own inset. Default false.

props.name: glass
props.description: This panel's own material level; see Surface `glass`. Default: the page's.

props.name: scroll
props.description: Let the body scroll inside a bounded panel instead of growing the page.

props.name: children
props.description: The content or component slots rendered inside the component.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: ref
props.description:
Allows getting a ref to the component instance.
Once the component unmounts, React will set `ref.current` to `null`
(or call the ref with `null` if you passed a callback ref).
